title: Header::read does not check the file version; the open path does
body:
`SufrFile::read` stores the version byte (`libsufr/src/sufr_file.rs:145`, kept as `version` at 249) and never compares it with `OUTFILE_VERSION` (6, `libsufr/src/types.rs:16`). An older or newer file is read with the current layout. `util::read_text_length` (`libsufr/src/util.rs:95`) reads the same header at fixed offsets and also has no check that the survey could confirm.

Seen by reading the code in the survey. Not run against a file with another version.
